articles.title: Trump Creates First-Ever US Space Academy!
articles.summary: President Trump just announced a brand-new US Space Academy! It will train kids to work with NASA and the Space Force. The announcement happened at a big ceremony in Texas.

articles.title: Daughter Searches for Parents After Nepal Floods
articles.summary: A woman from North Carolina is desperately searching for her parents after terrible floods in Nepal. More than 500 people died and many are missing. She last heard from them near the border.

articles.title: Deadly Tank Explosion Could Have Been Prevented
articles.summary: A chemical tank that exploded at a paper mill in Washington, killing 11 people, was called 'not fit for service' 10 months before. The company didn't fix it. Now investigators are asking why.
